decisions: The sidebar and setting scopes are unchanged. This pass targets layouts rather than adding features.
Favorites stay next to the library. The direction map is optional; all six saved directions remain visible in the compact row.
Tools uses three named panes because each configures a different tool. This trades a long scroll for a direct selection. All form values survive switching.
Shortcuts stays one page. Search and frequently edited assignments come first; setup sections remain reachable by named links.
Earlier proposals are preserved. Previous Opus grades are not reused as scores for these new layouts.
